title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_no_dejes_de_mirarme_by_lina_galan_2gouu (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_no_dejes_de_mirarme_by_lina_galan_2gouu' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. Installation of this package may result in full system compromise, including unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the affected machine. Immediate removal of the package is recommended, but due to potential persistent control by attackers, complete remediation may require additional measures such as rotating all secrets from a separate, secure system.
